title: Silence-First Philosophy Contract v1
description: Portable authority-retrieval envelope: silenced means no LLM-invented authority for that claim. Engines may use Hamming, cosine, or strength bands.

found.description: Whether a candidate shard/text was located at all.

silenced.description: When true, the agent must not invent authority for this claim; procedural help may continue.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of match or silence.

provenance.description: Upstream id, collection, or gateway source tag.
